title: Agent Execution Trace
description: Schema for logging agent interactions with the UX Dataset for audit and reproduction.

agent_id.description: Name or ID of the agent performing the task.

data_source.description: Reference to the specific data point used.

identifier.description: Key or ID to locate the specific record (e.g., 'id=501').

prompt_input.description: The exact input provided to the model.

variables.description: Key-value pairs collected from context and injected into the template.

cot_trace.description: The recorded Chain-of-Thought or reasoning steps.

final_output.description: The structured output generated by the agent.

reproduction_status.description: Audit status determined by the Tracking Agent.
